call.target_note: the callee is not an FDE start, so no body size is claimed for it; it is the shared comparator also used by the killed cmovbe family, but this window is not a family member (see README)

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

function.padding_note: no int3 padding follows this window: the next FDE begins immediately at 0x5430e07 (a 69-byte neighbor window, excluded here), and the 4 int3 bytes at [0x5430e4c, 0x5430e50) belong after that neighbor, not after this window

rule.derived_formula: return 1 iff b_second <= a_second (unsigned) and (b_second == 0 or callee_result == 0); the checker verifies the raw and derived formulas agree on every edge below

edges.note: min == 0 skips the callee gate entirely; callee_result is meaningless here
b_second > a_second, gap -3 in range but low32 != 0
trap: min == 0 path, gap -2**32 has low32 == 0 but is out of the i32 range, so the range guard rejects
trap: callee == 0 but gap -2**32 is out of range despite low32 == 0
boundary: gap -2**31 is in range but low32 0x80000000 != 0
b_second <= a_second at the top of the range, gap 0
mod-arithmetic edge: gap mod 2**64 is 2, in range but nonzero

rule.formula_note: gap is always <= 0 before the mod (min <= b_second), so a positive in-range gap never occurs; the range guard is only observable on negative gaps whose low 32 bits are zero (notably -2**32)
rule.inputs: a_first (u64 at input a + 0x00), a_second (u64 at input a + 0x08), b_first (u64 at input b + 0x00), b_second (u64 at input b + 0x08), callee_result (low 32 bits of eax from the call to 0x5660150 with (a_first, b_first, min))
rule.raw_formula: min = min_u64(a_second, b_second); if min != 0 and callee_result != 0: return 0; gap = (min - b_second) mod 2**64; return 1 iff gap_signed in [-2**31, 2**31 - 1] and low32(gap) == 0, else 0
